mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing weakness signals a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is below 100, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past six months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for six consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (as indicated by GDPC1 growth above 3.0% for two consecutive quarters), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 growth above 3.0% for two consecutive quarters, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown across manufacturing and residential sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
